authority_rule: This file is the declarative governance read-routing registry. It defines the deterministic routing_request and routing_result contract consumed by resolver implementations. Resolver implementations must not deviate from these profiles, conditions, and fail-closed rules.

planner.description: Planner role: owns epic closure and release readiness decisions.

architect.description: Architect role: owns ticket scoping, Runner dispatch, Validator dispatch, and review acceptance.

runner.description: Runner role: owns bounded ticket implementation within declared scope.

validator.description: Validator role: read-only contract executor producing Validation Reports.

knowledge_curator.description: Knowledge Curator role: owns knowledge entry eligibility and provenance.

conditional_rules.description: When a ticket declares validator_required, Architect and Planner must also read Validator protocol and verdict handoff.
Planner-side epic closure requires Validator protocol, verdict handoff tree, and validation contract for closure assessment. Epic format is already included in the Planner baseline and deduplicates.
Validation tasks add validation contract and primitive registry. Semantic validation adds semantic contract.
Semantic validation tasks additionally add the semantic validation contract.
Governance inventory, taxonomy, or routing tasks add governance references.
Knowledge curation or review tasks add the knowledge contract.
Runtime implementation tasks add runtime architecture only. Narrower runtime contract refs require explicit ticket/dispatch declaration.

fail_closed_rules.detail: Ref does not resolve to any active inventory entry. Caller must provide a valid path, document_id, or canonical_for topic.
Ref resolves to more than one active inventory entry. Caller must disambiguate with explicit path or document_id.
Target is superseded or inactive. Caller must reference the active version.
Ref resolves only to Guide documents. Guides are non-normative and cannot satisfy a contract ref. Caller must provide a normative target.
Ref cannot be resolved deterministically. Do not guess by filename similarity, substring, or prose context.

ref_resolution.heuristic_prohibition: The resolver must never guess by filename similarity, substring matching, timestamp, or prose context. All resolution is blocked until the caller provides an exact match.

output_rules.deduplication: Deduplicate by first occurrence. A reference appearing earlier in the ordered output is not repeated.
output_rules.guide_policy: Guides are never normative. They are not part of normative_reads. They may be included in supplemental_guides only when explicitly requested via explicit_guide_refs.
output_rules.minimum_read_principle: Route only selected authorities. A route must include at least one Protocol and one applicable Policy, except for the Validator profile which uses its dedicated protocol/policy set.
